Container.Name: photocraft-web
Container.Overview: PhotoCraft Web is a community-maintained Docker image that provides PhotoCraft through a native browser-based interface. Unlike desktop-in-a-container solutions that require accessing a remote Linux desktop, this version serves PhotoCraft's WebAssembly application directly to your browser. No Linux desktop environment, remote desktop session, or GPU passthrough is required. Image editing and processing run on the user's device inside a modern web browser. Open images directly from your computer using the browser's file picker, then save or export the results as browser downloads. The container only serves the web application. No database or persistent image-storage volume is required. Ideal for Unraid users who want a straightforward, browser-native PhotoCraft experience without running a remote Linux desktop.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: PhotoCraft Photo Craft Image Editor Photo Editor Image Editing Browser WebAssembly
Container.Requires: No special privileges or persistent data volumes are required. The web interface is served over HTTP by the container. When using a reverse proxy such as Traefik, configure the proxy to forward requests to the container HTTP port.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Port used to access the PhotoCraft Web interface.
